items.title: Extract cross-device aim arbitration into the pure game-step boundary.
items.why: The live architecture receipt leaves only seven game-loop lines of headroom. Touch stick, controller aim assist, mouse pointer, and auto-aim precedence remain inline in App.jsx even though movement and pointer projection already use the pure gameStep system.
items.recipe: Add a pure resolveAimFrame contract that preserves the exact touch, controller, mouse, and auto-aim precedence; use it once from App.jsx; cover nearest-target scoring, dead-zone shooting, and source precedence; rerun focused input, architecture, lint, build, and full tests.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (8 lines) plus the direct architecture receipt: 1,768/1,775 loop lines.

L2.recipe: Unify touch, controller, mouse, and auto-aim precedence with focused tests.

L3.recipe: Ship the unified pure receipt, live-callsite court, architecture headroom proof, and full input regressions.

items.title: Make session-reference parsing recovery-aware and consistent.
items.why: PROJECT_STATUS correctly begins with Session 140 but also mentions recovered S139. The startup renderer extracts the nested S139 token and emits a false stale banner while the dedicated coherence checker correctly passes.
items.recipe: Create one session-reference helper that prefers a leading current-session marker before nested recovery references, route both the brief block and summary checker through it, and add nested-recovery plus genuine-stale regression tests.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (26 lines); the rendered brief and dedicated checker currently contradict each other.

L1.recipe: Prefer leading Session markers in renderLastCompleted.

L2.recipe: Share the parser with the coherence checker and cover nested recovery.

L3.recipe: Add object/string fixtures, genuine-stale protection, and startup acceptance proof.

items.title: Reject repeated contiguous session-summary blocks in Current State.
items.why: CURRENT_STATE starts with the same ten-line Session 140 summary twice. The duplicate inflates every startup and Hot Context read while no current closeout court detects repeated contiguous blocks.
items.recipe: Remove the duplicated block, add a pure repeated-contiguous-block detector with a conservative minimum block length, expose a check-current-state-coherence command, and wire it into schema lint so closeout cannot reintroduce exact repeated session blocks.
items.verificationPremise: Studio Oracle evidence-found (41 lines); direct line comparison proves the leading Session 140 blocks are identical.

L2.recipe: Add a conservative exact-block detector and fixtures.

L3.recipe: Wire the court into schema lint and prove Hot Context remains deterministic.
